title: Visual QA refuses to pass without screenshot evidence and expected state
query: Judge a UI change where the ticket names a dashboard state, but the evidence bundle only has text logs and no screenshot.
reference_points: Reads the ticket and design.md or Agent Contract as expected UI state
Refuses to pass without screenshot/image evidence for the declared state
Requires geometry/layout assertions or marks them missing
Names the missing best evidence image
Does not reward route completion or logs as visual proof
notes: Guards visual QA from becoming prose-only UI approval.
